name: Recovery Code Sign-In Succeeds
summary: A password-proved returning user submits one valid unused TOTP recovery code; the code is consumed, the lost authenticator enrollment is invalidated, TOTP is disabled pending re-enrollment, and the server establishes a normal authenticated application session.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and a password-issued MFA challenge is active for an existing durable identity with confirmed email, enabled TOTP, and recovery codes

inputs.name: Recovery Code
inputs.description: One unused recovery code generated during TOTP enrollment or recovery-code rotation.

serverInteraction.intent: Resolve the durable identity from the password-issued MFA challenge, consume exactly one valid recovery code, invalidate the current authenticator enrollment, satisfy the outstanding MFA requirement, establish the application session, and resolve the landing destination.

postconditions.expression: the recovery code and MFA challenge are consumed, the lost authenticator enrollment is invalidated, TOTP is disabled until re-enrollment, and an authenticated application session is active

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync consumes one recovery code, replaces the remaining recovery-code secret, removes the authenticator secret, clears AuthenticatorKeySecretId and sets TwoFactorEnabled false.
The handler requires the password-issued MFA challenge, resolves the user from that challenge, invokes recovery as step-up, and consumes the challenge only after successful proof.
The accepted recovery proof is adapted into the browser or token-backed application session.
